candidate.document_name: April 2026 Producer Price Index Detailed Report, PDF

indexed_metadata_observations.claim: The official archive index lists April 2026 PDF and XLSX reports
The official BLS tables directory describes Table 9 as commodity/service indexes
The April 2026 archived news release is dated May 13, 2026
An indexed March 2026 PDF Table 9 displays an unadjusted-index schema
FRED labels WPU0561 Crude Petroleum (Domestic Production)

concept_label_review.governing_rule: Do not broaden from the exact target to domestic production or related variants to find an index field without a new owner methodology decision

gates.requirement: Exact official BLS PDF href recorded from archive listing
gates.fail_closed_rule: An exact BLS URL must be verified; guessed paths forbidden

gates.requirement: April 2026 document edition and May 13, 2026 publication provenance
gates.fail_closed_rule: News release date alone does not prove PDF publication or first-release immutability

gates.requirement: Archived PDF correction, replacement, and revision provenance
gates.fail_closed_rule: If original edition is unavailable or corrections unresolved, fail closed

gates.requirement: Governing April PDF Table 9 header has an unadjusted index-level column
gates.fail_closed_rule: Another month's Table 9 does not prove April schema

gates.requirement: Unique exact-series WPU0561 commodity identity proven in relevant table
gates.fail_closed_rule: Code, label, section, units, adjustment and underlying concept must agree

gates.requirement: Short Crude petroleum label versus domestic-production title adjudicated
gates.fail_closed_rule: FRED naming alone never authorizes variant acceptance; owner methodology ruling required

gates.requirement: 2013 HTML and 2026 PDF values refer to comparable series, bases and observation months
gates.fail_closed_rule: No silent rebase, semantic transformation or vintage blending

gates.requirement: Parser can perform an audited bounded structural-only preflight without unauthorized economic-value reads
gates.fail_closed_rule: No PDF/text extraction before a separately authorized contract

gates.requirement: Legal/redistribution review for Score public surface
One-off live structural preflight separately preregistered and approved
gates.fail_closed_rule: Consumed v8 receipt cannot be reused

adversarial_rejection_cases.trigger: A PDF URL is inferred from a naming pattern rather than verified on the official archive
A generic or current PPI PDF redirects to the latest month
The PDF has the wrong reference month or no first-release provenance
The April PDF is replaced or corrected and its first-release edition is not independently established
Table 9 does not exist, has no governing header, or exposes only percent-change fields
Only a seasonally adjusted series, relative importance, or a non-index measure is available
Multiple rows plausibly map to the target series without deterministic disambiguation
The row is an unrelated extraction, stage-demand, transport, pipeline, or domestic-production variant without approved identity reconciliation
The target code appears only in a footnote or unrelated container
A row matches by label but the commodity identifier or series scope conflicts
2013 and 2026 indexes use incompatible base periods, units or series definitions
Revision/preliminary tags conflict or cannot be attributed to the eligible observation
PDF text is rasterized, OCR ambiguous, a header is split or columns cannot be aligned unambiguously
The parsing step would materialize, log or persist unapproved economic values
The proposed workflow scans other source paths or retries network requests without bounded authorization
Source-value confirmation is obtained from current BLS database, FRED or a third-party mirror instead of the approved historical BLS primary document
The rights gate is interpreted as resolved by source availability or indexing feasibility
Approval of design is treated as authorization for live preflight, Score computation or publication
